Date: 2026-08-31T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Sudden Q3 spike — need short-term GPU add before renewal

Hey Sean,

Quick note — we saw a ~3.8x increase in peak token throughput over the last 48 hours tied to a new feature rollout. Current Dedicated pool is hitting sustained 85–92% GPU util at peak windows and latency is slipping. Our renewal is late September but we can't wait that long.

Can Redwood do a short-term provisioning plan (add-on tranche or temporary burst) and a checklist of what changes we should make (autoscale, cache, model variant) so we don't regress? Procurement is ready to fast-track PO if the numbers are clear.

Attaching our internal traffic snapshot. Happy to hop on a 30-min call this week.

— Avery

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Quick call with Atlas ops + our infra engineers (30 min) — I can do today at 2pm PT.
- We'll run a utilization delta and propose: (A) temporary tranche add, (B) autoscale tweak, (C) cache prefix rule.
- I'll loop in our capacity lead (Dev) and account lead (Laura) to get pricing cadence for an expedited PO.

Looping you in — Laura/Dev, can you pull the recent GPU utilization summary and a back-of-envelope cost for a 4-GPU and 8-GPU add (A10G equivalent) for a 30-day burst?

— Sean

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T08:52:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Atlas AI — Q3 provisioning ask (urgent)

Team — copying the Atlas thread here so we can move fast. Key asks: 30-day burst plan + a short playbook for safe rollout and rollback. Attachments we'd publish: utilization summary (from Dev), cost table (from Laura), and recommended playbook doc (owner: Sean).

Please include:
- Exact GPU SKU suggestion (A10G vs A100 variant) and perf rationale.
- Expected delta in tail latency and throughput after tranche.
- Risk checklist (cache invalidation, KV warm-up, model fallback policy).
- Quick procurement language for a PO (term, price, start/end).

I expect to be on call with Atlas at 14:00 PT today to align.

— Sean

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Atlas AI — Q3 provisioning ask (urgent)

Sean / Laura — quick summary from infra:
- Confirmed spike concentrated 09:30–14:30 PT, sustained for last 3 discrete days.
- Current fleet: 16x A10G dedicated. Baseline avg util pre-spike: 52%; peak sustained now: 88%.
- CLI sampling + KV cache hit rates show prefix reuse of ~27% during spike window — opportunity to tune cache rules.

Sizing options (back-of-envelope):
- Option A: +4 A10G (25% added capacity) — reduces peak util to ~66% and should cut  p95 latency by ~18% in our perf model. Cost estimate: $8,400 for 30 days (list w/ expedited provisioning fee).
- Option B: +8 A10G (50% added capacity) — reduces peak util to ~48%; p95 latency down ~35%; Cost estimate: $15,200 for 30 days.
- Option C: Autoscale policy tweak + cache prefix rules (no tranche) — buys ~10–12% headroom but risks saturation if spike persists.

Recommendation: start with Option A + cache tuning + enable canary on one region shard. If spike continues beyond 10 days, escalate to Option B and convert to reserved tranche for the remainder of term.

Attaching: utilization_q2_summary.csv (generated from monitoring), cost_model_v2.xlsx (pricing lines).

— Dev
Dev Patel
Capacity Engineering — Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai

From: Avery Cloud <avery@atlasai.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@atlasai.com
Date: 2026-09-03T07:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden Q3 spike — need short-term GPU add before renewal

Thanks team — Option A looks like the least disruption and procurement will clear a fast PO if we get a short quote and start/end dates.

We can approve a 30-day burst starting 2026-09-09 if Redwood provides:
- Exact SKU(s) and hourly rate
- Expected latency improvement and monitoring checklist (we want an SLA fallback if >5% error surge)
- Simple acceptance test (5-min walk-through) so our SREs can verify after provision

Happy to take the call on Friday morning if that helps.

— Avery

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Cloud <avery@atlasai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-07T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden Q3 spike — need short-term GPU add before renewal

Avery — thanks, all. Attaching our "provisioning_playbook_v1.md" and the two reference files (utilization + cost). Summary below and next steps: 

Summary (Option A: +4 A10G burst for 30 days starting 2026-09-09):
- SKU: A10G-equivalent (dedicated pool), 4 GPUs.
- Cost: $8,400 for 30 days (expedited provisioning + setup).
- Expected perf impact: p95 latency ~ -18%, peak util down to ~66%.
- Operational steps: enable cache prefix rule for high-frequency prefixes, update autoscale window from 1m to 30s for burst window, and canary across shard-2 for first 2 hours.
- Acceptance test: run the supplied 5-min synthetic at peak traffic profile and verify p95 < baseline_target and error rate < 1%.
- Fallback: If error > 5% during canary, auto-fallback to prior autoscale policy and open a hot incident (SE team contact in playbook).

Procurement language (draft for PO):
- Service: Dedicated GPU short-term burst (4x A10G-equivalent)
- Term: 2026-09-09 to 2026-10-09
- Total: $8,400 (one-time invoice)

Next actions:
- Laura: finalize invoice line and payment terms (T+30?)
- Dev: schedule tranche provisioning for 9/9 02:00 PT and run canary plan
- Marissa: send a one-page exec note to Atlas summarizing SLA and fallback.
- Avery/procurement: provide PO by 2026-09-08 for 9/9 start.

I'll post the final playbook link here once Laura confirms invoicing. Thanks everyone — we'll treat this as a high-priority temporary expansion and revisit at renewal for a persistent tranche if utilization stabilizes.

— Sean
Sean Gallagher
